hero.title: Scan the DNS records attackers use to <brand>borrow your brand.</brand>
hero.text: Run a public DMARC and SPF diagnostic, see exactly why spoofed mail can pass, then request early access for beta automation, reporting, and a safe path to p=reject.

target.label: DMARC target
target.detail: Progress through monitor, quarantine, reject without breaking legitimate mail.

threat.title: Anyone can send email as your domain. Until you tell receivers not to let them.
threat.text: Email was built on trust, not identity. Without an enforced DMARC policy, a stranger can put your address in the From field and reach your customers. Flip the switch to see the difference.

workflow.title: From a public scan to an enforced policy — without breaking mail.
workflow.text: DMARK is built for the messy middle: legacy vendors, SPF lookup limits, report XML nobody reads, and DNS providers where one bad edit takes mail down.

discover.title: Discover
discover.detail: Find SPF, DMARC, DKIM, forwarding, and unknown senders — without asking anyone for credentials.

stabilize.title: Stabilize
stabilize.detail: Flatten SPF, remove stale includes, and document every DNS change before it ships.

enforce.title: Enforce
enforce.detail: Advance DMARC from none to quarantine to reject with report-backed confidence.

ladder.title: The enforcement ladder
ladder.detail: Most domains never leave the first rung.

features.title: Move from exposed DNS records to enforced domain trust.
features.text: The paid product is in early access: scanner evidence is public today, while SPF automation and reporting remain gated until their launch checks are boring.

flattening.title: SPF flattening in beta
flattening.detail: Keep Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, marketing tools, and local senders below the 10-lookup limit once the route is provisioned.

reporting.title: Readable reporting roadmap
reporting.detail: Turn XML into sender inventory, pass/fail trends, and the next safe enforcement decision as reporting gates finish.

rollout.title: Provider-aware rollout
rollout.detail: Copy-paste changes tailored for Icelandic DNS providers and reviewed for operational risk.

proof.title: Every recommendation should explain itself.
proof.text: The product view translates DMARC aggregate reports, SPF chains, and DNS records into the next action a business can safely approve.

items.title: Quarantine rollout
items.detail: Start at pct=25 for seven days

steps.title: An attacker sends mail “from” your domain
steps.detail: No password needed. SMTP lets anyone write your address in the From field.

steps.title: Your domain has p=none or none at all
steps.detail: Receivers have no instruction to reject unaligned mail, so it sails through.

steps.title: It lands in the inbox, looking legitimate
steps.detail: Your logo, your name, your customer — a convincing invoice or password reset.

footer.title: DMARK closes the gap.
footer.text: We get you to an enforced p=reject safely — without breaking the legitimate mail your business depends on.
